spots.text: THE LIBRARY, AS DRAWN. Sheet 1 of an uncountable number. Revision: none. Every room is marked "to be finished later". So is this one.

secrets.name: The Room Above
secrets.text: At the top of the scaffolding, through the hole: a room nobody has finished, bare concrete, a bedroll, and on the table the plans. They are drawn in pencil. They go on for ever.

meta.label: The Unfinished Room
meta.blurb: The masons have gone for lunch and not come back. The shelves are up, the books are not, and the dust is still settling from the last stone laid.
